purpose: Research on blood pressure control in primary care to update teaching material.
question: What is the mean systolic blood pressure of adults with hypertension, for women and for men?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Hypertension = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I10.
Systolic blood pressure = LOINC 8480-6. Use the latest value per patient; patients without a value are left out.
Report per sex: adults with hypertension who have a systolic blood pressure value and their mean systolic blood pressure, one decimal.
